***

***
## What is this?
I’ve archived most of the Non-OC Koikatu cards that were ever """released""".
They are sorted by franchise and then by character.
Last complete card trawl goes up to 07/2022, with only partial inclusion after that.
Sorting takes time... shit's hard y'all.
***

***
## Contents:
C4_Additions.7z ==> Character card archive
S4_Additions.7z ==> Scene archive
Tree (folders) ==> Treemap of folders, allows you to see franchises
Tree (files) ==> Treemap of files, allows you to see filenames
***

***
## Release Notes:
Right, let's get hard part out of the way: 

This is 180 GB compressed.....
and 500 GB uncompressed...
and this is just the new cards. 

The cards from the CCCCP torrent are not included, so please keep seeding that. 


In general, this pack has the same provisos as the CCCCP release, so read that page if you haven't already: https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3330941
***

***
## FAQ:
⠀


**Why is it so big?** 

I'm compensating.
For real though, idk. I was sure the game was declining in popularity, but we're averaging almost quadruple the update-size-per-time-frame compared to the CCCCP era.
⠀

**Why is this all in one big zip? Why couldn't you just zip each franchise/character folder?**
Even ignoring the increased torrent size, and fragmented seeding that would cause... 
Do you know how unwieldy the archive already is, before trying to zip up 5000+ folders of varying hierarchies? 
There's only one master copy so any slip-up would be catastrophic. 

And do you think I got the energy to backup versions of a 800+GB archive? This ain't no commercial-grade software platform. 
It's just one lone guy in his room.

⠀


**Character Popularity?**
796 Artoria (all forms)
586 Hatsune Miku
438 Mei (Honkai+Genshin forms)
423 Rem
397 Asuna Yuuki
334 Jeanne D'Arc (all forms)
333 Hinata Hyuga

⠀

**Any new site sources?**
Same as CCCCP, except:
2chan: Not included. I have the threads saved, but going through them takes so much time, and a lot is reposted to pixiv. May eventually get around to them.
5chan now included
shitaraba now included
komica now included
'beast party' now included
/vt/ now included
Various small blogs included
⠀

**Do you agree that SAO is the GOAT anime?**
Of course, I don't think there's even any room for debate.
⠀

**Update when??**
Whenever.
No, the archivist is not back. No, there is no schedule for further releases. Yes, all hope is lost, the end is nigh, and there's no free candy.
